resolved_findings.resolution: Runtime checked during each sample and again after all real consumers. Frozen inputs plus initial plan/manual/registration hashes rechecked at exit.
Final guard includes base sample files, all native-audit evidence files, raw native session hashes, actual artifacts, generated consumption records and manual input bindings.

Base evidence hashes captured at sample loop entry, before reads/consumers. Native-bound expected hashes come from the freshly replayed audit and must match any initial hash. sample.hashes records initial values, not post-consumer current values.
Output includes registration_sha256 alongside exact plan/manual/verifier hashes.

gate_obligations_reviewed: Registered plan hash and all frozen paths must match. Plan requires exactly five Sol-medium samples and fixture requires four artifacts plus ten decisions.
Worker plan/runner/arm/model/effort/version, terminal exit and native session identity are checked; fresh native audit must exactly equal the saved audit.
Production runtime root/commit/tree artifacts, policy, fixture, task and harness bindings are checked; fresh grade must equal saved14-case grade and pass.
Manual record must cover exactly five sample names and20 case reviews; each actual persisted artifact must equal captured producer text and saved artifact hash and carry a passing manual review.

Each actual artifact is consumed through real pinned profile show and architecture-proposal contract validation. Profile result must match supplied snapshot and recommendation must be in fixture allowance. Invented recommendation mutation must fail at exit1.

Gate output is written only after all20 artifacts and50 decisions pass with fresh native/source/manual/consumer checks. No partial sample collection can produce a passing gate under the current frozen plan.
limits: Static helper review only. No gate invocation or actual sample-artifact review is claimed here.
Baseline gate must wait for all five completed baseline samples and independent manual reviews; candidate launch remains subject to recorded passing baseline gate.
Real profile replay uses controlled stored-profile state. It is not profile acquisition, architecture-quality certification, procurement, ADR creation or full caller workflow execution.
Contract mutation checks invalid recommendation admission only; broader prose fidelity depends on the independent manual review and frozen fixture.
